title: LeagueBridge validation-evidence signature envelope
description: Envelope version 1 carries the exact validation-evidence-v2 payload bytes and a bounded Ed25519 reviewer quorum. The verifier must reject non-canonical base64url, duplicate key IDs, and signatures not ordered by strictly increasing key_id code-unit order; those relational and canonical-decoding rules are not expressible in JSON Schema alone.

payload.description: RFC 4648 base64url without padding. The verifier must decode and re-encode this value identically before parsing or verifying the exact decoded bytes.

signatures.description: Two to eight signatures, ordered by strictly increasing key_id. The verifier, rather than this schema, enforces ordering and unique key IDs.

signature.description: The raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature encoded as exactly 128 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
